privacy.mechanism: DP-FedAvg, client level: per-client L2 clipping of the full floating-point state update, sample-weighted aggregation with fixed public weights, Gaussian noise added once to the aggregate by a trusted server
privacy.privacy_unit_description: All training data of one simulated client (5 clients); add/remove-one-client adjacency with the other clients' aggregation weights held fixed
privacy.clip_scope: All floating-point state entries: conv/linear weights and biases, BatchNorm affine parameters and running statistics
privacy.clipping_norm_rationale: Fixed a priori (not tuned on client, validation or test data)
privacy.noise_multiplier_rationale: Smallest two-decimal value meeting target_epsilon at delta over 20 full-participation rounds (GDP accountant requires z >= 2.6843)
privacy.accountant_description: T-fold composition of the Gaussian mechanism is exactly mu-GDP with mu = sqrt(T)/z (Dong, Roth & Su 2019); epsilon from the analytic Gaussian conversion (Balle & Wang 2018). RDP (Mironov 2017) reported as an upper-bound cross-check.

comparator.description: Day 11 standard FedAvg, natural partition, same seeds (paired: same partition, initialization and training order)

paired_title: Seed-paired comparison: same partition, initialization and training order; only client-level DP differs
